claim: Curve neurons are tuned to one orientation
published: each curve detector responds to curves in a narrow orientation band (radial tuning curves)
ours: median orientation selectivity 0.95 vs 0.10 for 20 random mixed3b neurons

claim: Curve neurons prefer curves to straight lines
published: near-zero activations are mostly straight lines; synthetic curves reach up to 24σ
ours: 10/10 neurons respond > 1.5× more to their best curve than to any straight line

published: the family covers the full circle (joint tuning curves)
